questionSnapshot.question: In what year did Disney Fantasy sail on its maiden voyage?

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Final challenge checks the exact named entity/event against each listed alternative, not merely a matching answer keyword.
